items.headline: Historic commission to review backyard unit at 1391 Washington Street
items.summary: On November 5, the Historical and Landmarks Commission is scheduled to hold a public hearing on a recommendation for a 1,200-square-foot detached accessory dwelling unit and a 347-square-foot detached garage at 1391 Washington Street, a property on the Historic Resource Inventory. The project (PLN26-00020) needs a Significant Property Alteration / Architectural Review and is listed as categorically exempt from CEQA.

items.headline: Historic commission to pick member for preservation ordinance consultant panel
items.summary: The Historical and Landmarks Commission's November 5 agenda includes selecting one commissioner to serve on the review board that will choose a consultant for the city's Historic Preservation Ordinance update. That update will shape how Santa Clara protects its historic properties.

items.headline: Sunnyvale historic context update to add Asian American and minority contributions
items.summary: The Heritage Preservation Commission's November 4 agenda listed a draft update to the city's Historical Context Statement to include contributions by Asian Americans and other minority groups, a Council priority project. The same agenda included a presentation on recent changes to SB 9 (via SB 450 and AB 1061) affecting two-unit developments and urban lot splits in single-family zones.

items.headline: Rosendin Electric office tenant improvement permitted at 3000 Orchard Parkway
items.summary: A building permit was issued for a tenant improvement at 3000 Orchard Parkway under the name Rosendin Electric, with a permit valuation of $10,255,535. It is an interior build-out of an existing office building and is the highest permit valuation in this batch.

items.headline: First Church receives permit for religious assembly space at 5891 Rue Ferrari
items.summary: A permit was issued for a religious assembly tenant improvement at 5891 Rue Ferrari, with a permit valuation of $2,225,000. It covers interior work in an existing building for First Church.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda lists $11.8M to buy Finch Avenue property
items.summary: The November 2 City Council consent calendar listed a budget modification adding $11,825,000 to the Parkland Dedication Fund to purchase the Finch Property at 10480 Finch Avenue. The agenda lists only the purchase and its funding source.

items.headline: McClellan Road Bridge design: $850K Caltrans grant, $1.28M contract listed
items.summary: The November 2 Council agenda listed a resolution to accept $850,000 in Caltrans-administered Community Project Funding and to award Biggs Cardosa Associates a design services agreement not to exceed $1,278,700 for the McClellan Road Bridge Project.

items.headline: Cupertino emergency plan update on November 2 council agenda
items.summary: The November 2 agenda listed a study session on proposed updates to the city's 2019 Emergency Operations Plan.
